title: Missing moeb tool: Read (spec prompt template session file)
description: The spec prompt template is saved as a tool-result file outside the moeb working directory. No moeb tool can read files from the session tool-results directory. The Read (native) tool was required to access it.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb tool that can read the current session's tool-result files, or update start_spec to inject the prompt template content directly into the MCP response rather than saving it to a separate file.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
